bio.en: Musician, scholar and archivist. A vocalist and bīṇākāra, he was trained by his grandmother Kanak Lata Sabath and Brundabana Khandual before studying under Ramarao Patro, in the lineage of Tarini Charan Patra. He is a research scholar at Berhampur University, working on the 17th-century treatise Saṅgītanārāyaṇa.
